subject: [PATCH 04/16] selftests/mm: add order-parameterized khugepaged collapse cases

2026-08-02.patch_summary: This patch adds selftest cases to the khugepaged module, which is responsible for collapsing huge pages in the Linux kernel. The new test cases are order-parameterized, meaning they can be run at different page orders (e.g., 2, 3, 5, etc.). This allows testing of the khugepaged collapse behavior at various page sizes. The patch also includes a new case to test mixed-source folios collapsing to the target order. The goal is to ensure that the khugepaged module works correctly with different page orders and configurations.
